title: コーヒーこぼすな ～COFFEE WALK～
subtitle: 右へ動くと、コーヒーは左へ。
duration_note: numeric design hypotheses; human natural failure and timing unmeasured
escalation_mechanic: Frozen500m offer adds boss's cup with150% future distance points; only two-cup runs receive1000m offer to add chairman's cup for200% future points.
risk_reward: Additional cups have independent frequency, damping and phase. The first emptied cup ends the run; previously earned points remain unchanged.
visual_identity: first-person illustrated morning street, live clipped coffee surfaces and warm cafe receipt UI
